title: Figure 4. Manipulated Extra Dimension: wireframe bulge with outward arrows
description: Wireframe mesh of a thin line that swells into a lens-shaped bulge, with arrows inside pointing outward to indicate a locally enlarged extra dimension. Caption: "Figure 4. Manipulated Extra Dimension", noting that a technology able to manipulate an extra dimension could locally adjust dark energy density. Accompanies section "7. Warp Drive and Higher Dimensional Manipulation".
